display-board.purpose: Hero destination letters only (H-A-R-I-S), set inside flap cells.

display.purpose: Chapter h2 announcements; em flips to amber.

label.purpose: All chrome text: uppercase Martian Mono, wide tracking.

shadows.name: flap-curl-top
shadows.purpose: Upper edge curvature of every flap cell; the only shadow family in the system (inset-only).

shadows.name: flap-curl-bottom
shadows.purpose: Lower edge curvature of every flap cell; applied together with the top curl via one overlay.

motion.name: ease-flap
motion.purpose: The single easing of the world: flaps, trays, lifts, arrivals.

motion.name: dur-tick
motion.purpose: Hover ticks: color, border, small transforms.

motion.name: dur-panel
motion.purpose: Tray pull-downs and below-fold row letter resolution.

motion.name: flip-stagger
motion.purpose: Hero cell-to-cell delay (--i * flip-stagger); row chars 22ms (--j), fades 90ms, route dots 160ms.

components.name: Flap Cell
components.description: Signature ivory split-flap tile with visible slit line and inset curl; hero board lettering only.
components.css: .ds-flap-cell { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; background: var(--flap-face, #EDE6D6); color: var(--ink-on-flap, #1A1712); border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); font-family: var(--font-display, Anton, Impact, sans-serif); text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1; font-size: clamp(3.4rem, 11vw + 1rem, 9.5rem); padding: 0.05em 0.17em 0.005em; min-width: 0.76em; } .ds-flap-cell::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; box-shadow: inset 0 7px 9px -7px rgba(26,23,18,.6), inset 0 -7px 9px -7px rgba(26,23,18,.6); pointer-events: none; } .ds-flap-cell::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; top: 50%; height: 1px; background: var(--flap-slit, #B8AE9A); pointer-events: none; }

components.name: Primary Plate
components.description: The one primary action per context: solid Solari amber plate with lamp ring.
components.css: .ds-plate-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-plate, 3px); background: var(--amber, #E8A33D); border: 1px solid var(--amber, #E8A33D); color: var(--ink-on-flap, #1A1712); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; transition: transform var(--dur-tick, 140ms) var(--ease-flap, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)), filter var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease; } .ds-plate-primary .ds-lamp { width: 0.55em; height: 0.55em; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid currentColor; } .ds-plate-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-plate-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Plate
components.description: Secondary action: hairline-bordered ticket plate whose lamp ignites amber on hover.
components.css: .ds-plate-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.65rem; padding: 1rem 1.5rem; border-radius: var(--radius-plate, 3px); background: transparent; border: 1px solid rgba(237,230,214,.30); color: var(--ink-bright, #EDE6D6); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.76rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: transform var(--dur-tick, 140ms) var(--ease-flap, cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.3,1)), border-color var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease; } .ds-plate-ghost::before { content: ''; width: 0.55em; height: 0.55em; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid currentColor; transition: background var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease, border-color var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease; } .ds-plate-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--amber, #E8A33D); } .ds-plate-ghost:hover::before { background: var(--amber, #E8A33D); border-color: var(--amber, #E8A33D); } .ds-plate-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Tag
components.description: Hairline-outlined mono metadata chip for disciplines and tech stacks.
components.css: .ds-tag { display: inline-block; padding: 0.45rem 0.8rem; border: 1px solid rgba(237,230,214,.30); border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #A29A8C); }

components.name: Status Badge Done
components.description: Completed-state timetable badge: outlined pill with slit-tone dot.
components.css: .ds-badge-done { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.32rem 0.65rem; border: 1px solid rgba(237,230,214,.30); border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-bright, #EDE6D6); } .ds-badge-done::before { content: ''; width: 0.5em; height: 0.5em; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--flap-slit, #B8AE9A); }

components.name: Status Badge WIP
components.description: Active-state badge: solid Solari amber pill with ink dot.
components.css: .ds-badge-wip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; padding: 0.32rem 0.65rem; border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); background: var(--amber, #E8A33D); color: var(--ink-on-flap, #1A1712); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.10em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-badge-wip::before { content: ''; width: 0.5em; height: 0.5em; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--ink-on-flap, #1A1712); }

components.name: Status Strip
components.description: Amber board announcement strip with pulsing lamp.
components.html: Now Boarding — Selected Works
components.css: .ds-status-strip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.7rem; margin: 0; background: var(--amber, #E8A33D); color: var(--ink-on-flap, #1A1712); padding: 0.62rem 1.2rem; border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.66rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-strip .ds-lamp-dot { flex: none; width: 0.55em; height: 0.55em; border-radius: 50%; background: currentColor; animation: ds-lamp-pulse 2.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-lamp-pulse { 0%, 100% { opacity: 1; } 50% { opacity: 0.25; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-status-strip .ds-lamp-dot { animation-duration: 0.01ms; animation-iteration-count: 1; } }

components.name: Station Nav Link
components.description: Header wayfinding chip: bordered mono caps link that brightens on hover.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { display: inline-block; padding: 0.5rem 0.85rem; border: 1px solid rgba(237,230,214,.14); border-radius: var(--radius-flap, 2px); font-family: var(--font-mono, Menlo, monospace); font-size: 0.66rem; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-muted, #A29A8C); text-decoration: none; transition: color var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease, border-color var(--dur-tick, 140ms) ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: var(--ink-bright, #EDE6D6); border-color: rgba(237,230,214,.45); } .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #E8A33D; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: 2px; }

narrative.overview: The site is a living Solari-style departure board. Every work is a scheduled train, every chapter an announcement, every piece of chrome is drawn from board hardware: flaps, slits, plates, lamps. Content sits inside a matte warm-black housing like machinery behind glass; ivory flap cells are the only place type is set dark-on-light, and they appear exactly where the board announces. The page refuses the card-grid portfolio: works are departure rows that pull down into trays, the stack diagram is a route line with stations, the archive is a timetable, contact is a row of ticket plates. Motion is the board's native mechanics, nothing more: letters resolve letter-by-letter when a row arrives, lamps pulse, trays pull down. Every hidden-until-arrival state is gated behind html.js so a no-JS visit sees the complete, static board.
keyCharacteristics: Matte warm-black housing; depth by tonal layering, never drop shadows
One accent (Solari amber #E8A33D) owns headers, status, focus, selection, and the single primary action
Ivory flap cells with a visible horizontal slit line are the signature module
All metadata/chrome text is uppercase Martian Mono with wide tracking
Radius vocabulary is exactly two values: 2px (flaps) and 3px (plates)
Hairlines separate everything; there are no cards in grids
Native cursor always; custom cursor prohibited

rules.name: The Solari Amber Rule
rules.body: Amber owns headers, status, and the one primary action - nothing else. If a second amber element competes with the primary plate on one screen, one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Red Reserve Rule
rules.body: Signal red appears only when something is genuinely wrong or urgent. It has zero call sites today; shipping it on routine chrome breaks the reserve.

rules.name: The Ink Naming Rule
rules.body: Token convention is binding: --ink-* names are text COLORS, --text-* names are font SIZES ONLY. Never cross them.

rules.name: The Three-Layer Binding Rule
rules.body: Every glyph belongs to exactly one layer - Anton announces, Archivo explains, Martian Mono records. No fourth face, no layer blending.

rules.name: The Mono Chrome Rule
rules.body: Anything that is not a heading or reading copy is uppercase Martian Mono with wide tracking. If you're writing chrome text in sentence case, it's off-system.

rules.name: The Inset-Only Depth Rule
rules.body: Shadows may only be inset, and only to model flap curvature. External drop shadows do not exist in this world.

dos: Do gate every hidden-until-arrival state behind html.js - the static page must be complete without JavaScript.
Do reuse the lamp-dot language for any new status (filled amber = active, pulsing = live, hollow = pending) before inventing new furniture.
Do keep new panels honest: hairline border, 3px radius, panel background, slit bar if it's a "desk" surface.
Do set all chrome text in uppercase Martian Mono with 0.10-0.22em tracking.
Do stack tables on mobile via td::before { content: attr(data-label) } instead of horizontal scroll.
Do test any new idea against the PRODUCT.md slop test: "Could this appear on 500 other AI-generated portfolios?" If yes, redraw it as board hardware.
donts: Don't add a second accent or spend amber twice in one viewport; if red leaves its reserve, it needs an actual alarm.
Don't introduce external drop shadows, gradients, glow, glassmorphism, or radii beyond the 2px/3px vocabulary.
Don't implement a custom cursor - the native cursor is mandated and untouched in base.css.
Don't animate anything that doesn't announce arrival, status, or wayfinding; no scroll-jacking, no parallax.
Don't present placeholder specs/metrics as fact - trays carry their "Illustrative specification" disclaimers.
Don't grow the font cast beyond the Anton/Archivo/Martian Mono binding.
